# Storefront and admin

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../apps/storefront)

Human and API entry to Cambridge TCG data infrastructure: SKU identity, images, prices and market observations, alongside collector tools, retained account records and the operator console.

**Scope:** Current application; new paid commerce is retired. Existing agreements, records, refunds and support remain in scope.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `cambridgetcg-storefront`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. The 2026-09-29 rebuild adds card-data contracts, room records, collector services and shared roadmap/standards registries. On 2026-10-27 the interface returned to the quiet gallery's core look (paper, ink and one bronze accent; midnight and gilt in dark; Fraunces headings, mats and hairlines) with a rebuilt brand kit. Shared image publication checks now serve market/universal English-base references and separate starter/practice card-number references. Image credit and selected variant context survive practice setup/saves, with bounded browser enrichment, readable text faces and accessible card inspection. Existing attributed text remains. Native-price writes and member reads now share monetary, mapping and source-scope checks before storage or publication. 2026-10-28 (Yu's decision on CardRush, Cardmarket and TCGplayer data and paid data-API plans): migrations 0139–0143, not applied to production by this work, release CardRush and TCGplayer for member display only and forward-only, add append-only source crosswalks (lib/datafeed/crosswalks.ts), derived-market tables whose reference prices need two sources Cambridge does not export, test-mode data-API customer, subscription, usage and rate tables, and collector leases; the plan catalogue is lib/data-api/plans.ts. The member reader shows those page sources only in current views of at most 50 rows. Later on 2026-10-28, each inert behind its switch and off by default: the Cardmarket daily collector (One Piece only; set crosswalk seed cardmarket-expansions/2026-10-28.1, products unmapped; DATA_COLLECT_CARDMARKET), the CardRush page collector (DATA_COLLECT_CARDRUSH), the TCGplayer price-guide collector (DATA_COLLECT_TCGPLAYER), one run at a time through collector leases (0143), the market derivation job (lib/market-derived; DATA_DERIVE_MARKET), the derived-data reads and account usage (lib/data-api; DATA_API_READS, with the plan catalogue under DATA_API_PLANS_PUBLISHED), and test-mode data-API billing (DATA_API_CHECKOUT_INTAKE closed by default; admins only in test). PostgreSQL integration tests check the migrations' guards, the collectors, leases, derivation, reads and billing store against a throwaway database. Independent readers and removal remain open; no provider activation, verified printing coverage or public package release is claimed.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Consolidate artist/gallery and retained PvP media paths, review catalog fallback provenance and implement removal across objects/caches. Then strengthen printing mappings, join qualified images/prices and pilot permitted providers. Check release readiness independently; preserve existing agreements and source/account boundaries.
